items.title: Derek Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe and Michael Woods, Majesty of the Seas, May 29, 1995
items.q: I was in the NBC band with Doc Severinsen

ctx.x: But then, years later, you know I was getting successful then, I was in the NBC band with Doc Severinsen and then, as soon as I finished “The Tonight Show” at seven I’d run upstairs and play with Benny Goodman at the Rainbow Grill, it was all in the same building. I was working like night and day. And I got very close to Benny then, and that was an equal mistake. He would call me up and say, “well what do you think of so-and- so, what do you think of so-and-so,” before they hired them. And then the ax fell, as it…
Tell us a little more about working on the Tonight Show band.
